$comment: What Conversational BI needs from the host monorepo. Kept in sync with server/package.json by a test (lift.test.ts).

@mastra/core.why: Agents, tools and the HTTP server; needs Node 22.13 or later

@mastra/libsql.why: Storage for agent runs and memory (LibSQL file or in-memory)

zod.why: Request, event and settings validation. Version 4: check GC's zod version before merging into one root package.json

mastra.why: Mastra CLI: build and dev server
